fact_text: IT exporters asked the FY26 budget for a withholding tax exemption for registered freelancers, including those registered with the Pakistan Software Export Board.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Budget FY 2025-26: What It Means for Tech Experts & Freelancers | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-04)

fact_text: The IT sector asked for the final tax regime exemption, granted for 10 years and expiring in 2026, to be extended by another 10 years in the FY26 budget.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Budget FY 2025-26: What It Means for Tech Experts & Freelancers | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-04)

fact_text: The IT sector asked for sales tax adjustability on IT products, which the speaker said other products already get as a margin adjustment, in the FY26 budget.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Budget FY 2025-26: What It Means for Tech Experts & Freelancers | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-04)

fact_text: The speaker described freelancers and IT exporters as a major source of foreign exchange, and said the State Bank and the IT ministry were focused on raising that inflow in FY26.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Budget FY 2025-26: What It Means for Tech Experts & Freelancers | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-04)

fact_text: The speaker argued that heavier taxes on freelancers' foreign earnings push them to open foreign bank accounts and move abroad, which would cut foreign exchange inflows.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Budget FY 2025-26: What It Means for Tech Experts & Freelancers | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-04)

fact_text: The speaker said no technology-sector IPO had been seen as of June 2025, even though the stock exchange was performing well and startups were declining.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Budget FY 2025-26: What It Means for Tech Experts & Freelancers | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-04)

fact_text: The speaker argued that tech investment needs consistent policy and a roadmap built with implementing bodies and exporters, since people serving on many committees cannot deliver results.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Budget FY 2025-26: What It Means for Tech Experts & Freelancers | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-04)
